subject: Request: temporary throttle hike + blended true-up for launch
messages:
From: Sara Wong <sara.wong@nexly.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Nexly Billing <billing@nexly.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary throttle + true-up for launch week

Hi Markus,

Quick background: we’ve got a soft launch the week of Sep 28 (internal push on the 29th) and our traffic model shows a short, sharp spike in inference requests — roughly 3x our committed QPS for a 48–72 hour window. We ran the attached consumption snapshot from last week to project the gap.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood approve a short-term throttle increase for that window (we need capacity elevated for 72 hours)?
2) How will overrun billing work for this one-off spike — we want to avoid sticker shock and are open to a blended true-up or pre-agreed uplift rate. Also curious whether there’s anything you can do on discounts if we lock a 6‑month commit after launch.

Timing is tight — procurement/finance will need a line item and an estimated invoice impact so they can approve a PO quickly. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Attachments: nexly_consumption_snapshot_sep17.csv (CSV, 42KB)

Thanks,
Sara Wong
Head of Platform
Nexly Labs
+sara.wong@nexly.ai
(555) 412-0921

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Wong <sara.wong@nexly.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary throttle + true-up for launch week

Sara —

Thanks for the data and heads-up. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary uplift; below is a pragmatic path that balances predictability for Nexly and protection for both sides.

Proposal (72-hour uplift window):
- Temporary quota uplift to 3x committed QPS for 72 hours starting at your specified UTC window.
- Blended overrun rate: 1.4x of your current pay-as-you-go token rate for all tokens above the committed volume during the uplift window. This is a one-off, pre-agreed uplift to avoid variable surcharges post-hoc.
- If you convert to a 6-month reserved capacity within 14 days of the uplift we’ll provide a 10% credit on the uplift charges (applied as a credit to the first month’s invoice).

Operational notes:
- We’ll need a signed PO or email approval from Nexly Billing to lock the uplift and schedule the window.
- Legal/Finance will execute a 1-page amendment (I’ve looped Jordan and Ben to help expedite).
- Invoice split: we can either bill the uplift as a single line on the monthly invoice or provide a separate proforma invoice for procurement — let me know which Nexly prefers.

If that sounds acceptable, I can have Jordan send a one‑page amendment and a proforma estimate by EOD tomorrow. Happy to run through the numbers on a 20-min call — here’s a quick scheduling link: https://calendly.com/markus-redwood/20

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Wong <sara.wong@nexly.ai>, Nexly Billing <billing@nexly.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Temporary throttle + true-up for launch week

Markus / Ben — forwarding Nexly’s ask and Markus’s outline. I drafted a short amendment that captures the uplift window, blended rate, and the 10% credit conditional on a 6‑month commit. See attached: draft-amendment-temporary-uplift-v1.pdf.

Key points for legal/finance review:
- Clear start/end UTC timestamps for the uplift window (we should request Nexly to confirm exact hours).
- Blended rate calculation: explicit formula (1.4x * standard PAYG rate) and example line showing token counts -> uplift charge.
- Purchase order flow: accept email approval from billing@nexly.ai as execution authority to avoid signing delay.

I can convert this to a DocuSign envelope once legal signs off. Ben — could you run an invoice estimate for the uplift using the attached consumption snapshot and send a proforma? Sara — if you can confirm the uplift start date/time window (UTC) we’ll generate the numbers.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Wong <sara.wong@nexly.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Nexly Billing <billing@nexly.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary throttle + true-up for launch week

Folks —

Appreciate the quick turn. We reviewed the draft and the proforma estimate internally. We accept the uplift terms as outlined (72 hours at 3x QPS, blended rate at 1.4x PAYG).

Next steps from our side: billing@nexly.ai will issue a PO referencing deal NX-4682 by end of day tomorrow. We prefer the uplift as a separate line on the monthly invoice. Please proceed with DocuSign for the amendment and send the proforma so procurement can match the PO.

One ask: can the invoice include a brief explanatory line item that states: "Temporary uplift (72h) — blended true-up; credit applies on 6‑month reserved conversion" — procurement prefers explicit wording.

Thanks again — saved us a lot of back-and-forth.

—Sara
Head of Platform, Nexly Labs
